title: What is seekdb
text: seekdb is an AI-native search database from OceanBase. It unifies relational data, dense vectors, full-text search, JSON and semi-structured data in one MySQL-compatible engine. A single SQL statement can combine vector similarity, keyword retrieval and scalar filters, which makes seekdb useful for local knowledge bases and agent memory.

title: 数据库内混合检索
text: seekdb 的混合检索不是由客户端分别请求向量结果和全文结果后再拼接。应用把一个全文查询条件、一个稠密查询向量和 RRF 排名参数交给 seekdb。数据库在同一执行计划中读取全文索引与向量索引，并返回融合后的有序结果。这样可以减少网络往返，同时保证候选集合与去重逻辑一致。

title: WebGPU 优先与 WASM 降级
text: The application checks navigator.gpu before loading the embedding pipeline. When an adapter is available, Transformers.js initializes ONNX Runtime Web with the WebGPU execution provider. If adapter discovery or pipeline initialization fails, the application records the failure and automatically loads the same FP16 model on the WASM execution provider. The active backend and weight precision are always shown in the interface.

title: FP16 quantization
text: The embedding weights use FP16. The public FP32 ONNX model occupies about 90.3 MB in the pinned repository, while the FP16 model and its external data file occupy about 45.2 MB. The weight-only compression ratio is approximately 2.0x. Evaluation must use the same corpus and query set when comparing retrieval quality.

title: 浏览器本地推理
text: Document and query embeddings are generated by Transformers.js inside a dedicated Web Worker running on the user's computer. Downloading model files is not cloud inference. No document text or query is sent to a hosted embedding API. The Node.js backend only stores precomputed embeddings together with text and metadata, and performs database retrieval.

title: 增量导入与索引刷新
text: Each imported file is split into overlapping chunks and assigned deterministic IDs derived from the document SHA-256 hash. Re-importing the same content updates existing chunks and removes stale tail chunks. After upsert, the application calls collection.refresh_index(), then probes the vector index with a filtered nearest-neighbor query until the new chunk becomes visible. Only after this visibility barrier does the import report success.

title: 批次与性能记录
text: Embedding work is grouped into batches. The interface records model download and initialization separately from query embedding, seekdb retrieval and end-to-end latency. First-load results are kept separate from warmed requests. Repeated measurements should report median values rather than selecting the fastest run.

title: 知识库会话状态
text: Every knowledge base has a stable catalog ID and a separate seekdb collection. The browser stores only the active knowledge-base identifier in localStorage. Switching a knowledge base reloads its document registry from seekdb and all future writes and searches target that collection. Import operations are serialized per knowledge base to prevent interleaved updates.
